failure.error: ValueError: Labels' sequence length 536 cannot exceed the maximum allowed length of 448 tokens
failure.cause: One training transcript tokenises to 536 label tokens against Whisper's max_target_positions of 448. Lazy audio/label loading means a 3-step preflight touches ~48 of 4,619 rows, so no preflight could have found it.

resumability.reason: died at step 59; the first checkpoint is at step 100

dataset.note: This mix was built BEFORE allowed_use was enforced, so it included 2,305 rows whose v1 allowed_use did not permit asr_train. See decision LIC-2026-001. No checkpoint was produced, so nothing derived from those rows persists from this run.
